description_en: Modifies the configuration of a cloud service that is connected to WAF
description_zh: 修改已接入WAF的产品配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-cloud-resource --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --listen '{"CustomCiphers":["ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:AES128-GCM-SHA256:AES256-GCM-SHA384"],"TLSVersion":"tlsv1.2","Http2Enabled":true,"CipherSuite":1,"EnableTLSv3":true,"Port":80,"ResourceProduct":"clb7","Certificates":[{}],"Protocol":"http","ResourceInstanceId":"lb-000"}' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCloudResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The certificate type for the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

default: default certificate.

extension: extended certificate
fields.help_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

default：表示默认证书。

extension：表示拓展证书
fields.name: applied_type

fields.help_en: The certificate ID
fields.help_zh: 证书ID
fields.name: certificate_id

fields.help_en: The certificate information
fields.help_zh: 证书信息
fields.name: certificates

fields.help_en:
The type of cipher suite to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

1: all cipher suites.

2: strong cipher suites. This value can be selected only when TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.2.

99: custom cipher suites. This value can be selected only when TLSVersion is not set to tlsv1.3
fields.help_zh:
要添加的加密套件类型。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

1：表示添加全部加密套件。

2：表示添加强加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值为tlsv1.2时，可选择该取值。

99：表示添加自定义加密套件。仅 TLSVersion 取值不为tlsv1.3时，可选择该取值
fields.name: cipher_suite

fields.help_en: The custom cipher suites
fields.help_zh: 自定义加密套件
fields.name: custom_ciphers

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

true: TLS 1.3 is supported.

false: TLS 1.3 is not supported.

This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. When TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.3, this value must be true
fields.help_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本。

仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。当TLSVersion为tlsv1.3时，此值必须为true
fields.name: enable_tlsv3

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

true: HTTP/2 is enabled.

false (default): HTTP/2 is not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP2。

false（默认）：表示不开启HTTP2
fields.name: http2_enabled

fields.help_en: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF
fields.help_zh: 接入WAF的云产品端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The protocol type
fields.help_zh: 协议类型
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the resource
fields.help_zh: 资源的实例ID
fields.name: resource_instance_id

fields.help_en: The cloud service type
fields.help_zh: 云产品类型
fields.name: resource_product

fields.help_en:
The TLS version to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

tlsv1: Supports TLS 1.0 and later. Provides the highest compatibility and the lowest security.

tlsv1.1: Supports TLS 1.1 and later. Provides good compatibility and good security.

tlsv1.2: Supports TLS 1.2 and later. Provides good compatibility and the highest security.

tlsv1.3: Supports only TLS 1.3. Provides the highest security and the lowest compatibility
fields.help_zh:
要添加的TLS版本。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

tlsv1(支持TLS1.0及以上版本，兼容性最高，安全性较低。)

tlsv1.1(支持TLS1.1及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性较好。)

tlsv1.2(支持TLS1.2及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性最高。)

tlsv1.3(仅支持 TLS 1.3版本，安全性最高，兼容性较低。)
fields.name: tls_version

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable persistent connections. Valid values:

true (default): Persistent connections are enabled.

false: Persistent connections are not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true（默认）：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接
fields.name: keepalive

fields.help_en:
The number of requests that can reuse a persistent connection. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

After persistent connections are enabled, this parameter specifies how many requests can reuse a persistent connection
fields.help_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接
fields.name: keepalive_requests

fields.help_en:
The idle timeout period for persistent connections. Valid values: 10 to 3600. Default value: 3600. Unit: seconds.

Specifies how long an idle persistent connection can remain open before it is released
fields.help_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：10~3600，默认3600，单位：秒。

复用的长连接空闲多少长后释放
fields.name: keepalive_timeout

fields.help_en: The maximum request body size. Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 2. Unit: GB
fields.help_zh: 最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G
fields.name: max_body_size

fields.help_en:
The read timeout period. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
fields.help_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600
fields.name: read_timeout

fields.help_en: The specified custom request header field
fields.help_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value set for the custom request header field
fields.help_zh: 自定义请求头部字段设定的值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The traffic mark fields and values of the domain name, which are used to mark traffic processed by WAF
fields.help_zh: 域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量
fields.name: request_headers

fields.help_en:
The write timeout period. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
fields.help_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600
fields.name: write_timeout

fields.help_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

0: The client access traffic is not forwarded by any other Layer 7 proxy before reaching WAF.

1: WAF reads the first value in the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header as the client IP address.

2: WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address
fields.help_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

1：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

2：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP
fields.name: xff_header_mode

fields.help_en:
The list of custom fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format of ["header1","header2",……].

This parameter is required only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2, which indicates that WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address
fields.help_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数
fields.name: xff_headers

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use X-Forward-For-Proto to pass the protocol used by WAF. Valid values:

true (default): The protocol used by WAF is passed.

false: The protocol used by WAF is not passed
fields.help_zh:
X-Forward-For-Proto传递WAF的协议。取值：

true（默认）：表示传递WAF的协议。

false：表示不传递WAF的协议
fields.name: xff_proto

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF during cloud native mode connection.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id
